content.value_statement: Video production requires many creative and technical decisions. This skill selects suitable tools and structures workflows for demos, explainers, social clips, avatars, and generated footage.
actual_capabilities: Compares programmatic video, AI generation, avatar, editing, and repurposing approaches.
Recommends video tools based on platform, duration, budget, assets, and presenter requirements.
Builds production workflows for product demos, explainers, social clips, and personalized outreach.
Creates structured prompts with subjects, actions, camera movement, style, mood, and technical specifications.
Explains aspect ratios, caption needs, rendering choices, and model-specific strengths.
Guides repeatable production with Hyperframes, Remotion, HeyGen, and video generation APIs.
limitations: The skill provides guidance and examples but requires installed tools or external services to render videos.
Model features, availability, pricing, and output quality can change after publication.
Generated footage may distort text, interfaces, brands, locations, or consistent characters.
Users must provide suitable assets, service access, permissions, and human review.

use_cases.title: Create SaaS Product Demos
use_cases.description: Plan screen recordings, overlays, narration, captions, and exports for concise website or sales videos.

use_cases.title: Repurpose Long Videos
use_cases.description: Turn webinars, interviews, or podcasts into captioned clips sized for social platforms.

use_cases.title: Automate Video Variations
use_cases.description: Design repeatable templates and pipelines for personalized or data-driven video batches.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Basic Video
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a [length] [video type] for [platform]. Recommend an approach, aspect ratio, production steps, and required assets.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when starting a single video without a defined workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Video Tool
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [tool A] and [tool B] for [goal]. Consider quality, cost, workflow, technical requirements, and production scale.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when selecting between programmatic, avatar, editing, or generation tools.

prompt_templates.title: Write a Generation Prompt
prompt_templates.prompt: Create three prompts for [scene]. Specify subject, action, camera movement, visual style, lighting, mood, duration, and aspect ratio.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when preparing footage for an AI video model.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Automated Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a pipeline producing [quantity] videos from [data]. Include templates, assets, generation tools, quality checks, rendering, captions, and delivery.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for repeatable, personalized, or data-driven production.

output_examples.input: Plan a 60-second weekly product update without filming a presenter.
output_examples.output: Use an AI avatar for narration, real product captures for accuracy, programmatic overlays for callouts, captions for accessibility, and a reusable vertical template.

output_examples.input: Turn a webinar into short social clips.
output_examples.output: Clean the transcript in Descript, identify strong moments with Opus Clip, add captions in CapCut, then export vertical versions for each platform.

output_examples.input: Choose between Hyperframes and Remotion for automated videos.
output_examples.output: Choose Hyperframes for simple HTML-driven templates. Choose Remotion for complex React animations or large rendering workloads through Lambda.

best_practices: Define the audience, goal, platform, duration, and available assets before selecting tools.
Use real recordings for product interfaces and add generated visuals only where accuracy is less critical.
Test a small sample, review captions and branding, then scale the approved workflow.
anti_patterns: Do not ask generation models to render critical product interfaces, logos, or readable text.
Do not produce large batches before validating the script, template, timing, and output quality.
Do not ignore platform aspect ratios, captions, licensing, consent, or service costs.

faq.question: Can this skill render a finished video?
faq.answer: It can guide or implement workflows when required tools are available. Rendering still depends on local frameworks, APIs, credentials, and service access.

faq.question: Which programmatic framework should I choose?
faq.answer: Choose Hyperframes for straightforward HTML templates. Choose Remotion when React, advanced animation, or scalable Lambda rendering is important.

faq.question: Can it create AI avatar videos?
faq.answer: It can plan scripts and workflows for services such as HeyGen or Synthesia. The service must provide access and suitable permissions.

faq.question: Does it support short social videos?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers clip extraction, captions, platform styling, aspect ratios, and workflows for TikTok, Reels, Shorts, and LinkedIn.

faq.question: How accurate is AI-generated footage?
faq.answer: Quality varies by model and prompt. Review text, interfaces, brands, hands, faces, locations, continuity, and factual details before publishing.

faq.question: What information should I provide first?
faq.answer: Provide the video goal, audience, platform, length, presenter preference, available assets, technical stack, budget, and whether the workflow must repeat.
